$comment: Written by scripts/sales-shots.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

start.alt: The Fresh Terminal start screen: “A terminal that adapts to you. We grow together.” above one centered prompt, with the words of a sentence lighting up as tags.

typed.alt: The prompt with “make a page called Projects” typed: “make” is tagged as an action and “Projects” as a page.

edit.alt: A stage after two prompts: it made the page “Trip plan” and put it in the menu, says what changed with one Undo, and shows a light perspective grid behind the stage; the next prompt is lighting up with tags.

rename.alt: Renaming a stage by clicking its name in the top bar: the name is an input with “Lisbon trip” typed in.

tools.alt: The one-row top bar with the tools menu open: New stage, Actions, Replay (experimental), Language, Export and Import, Buy credits, Invite code, Settings and Terminal-talk (experimental).

actions.alt: Actions as a timeline: every prompt, reply and edit on this stage as a row with its status, model and cost, and arrows to what each one follows.

actions-board.alt: Actions as a board, one column per status.

offline.alt: A prompt typed with no connection waits on the stage, marked as queued, with Send now and Discard.

library.alt: A skinned terminal from the library, Paper and Typewriter: today’s date, a theme switched and undone, and the next prompt with tags.

replay.alt: Replay (experimental): the stage rebuilt at one step of the session, with a scrubber to move through every step.

phone.alt: Fresh Terminal on a phone: the stage with a new page and one Undo, and the prompt at the bottom with tags.
